headline: Homemade pies.
Proper pints.
copy.sub: A proper village pub on Alfriston High Street. Pies made here in small batches, well-kept ales, a fire in winter and a garden looking over the church.
copy.lede: Pop in after a walk on the South Downs Way. Grab a pint by the fire in winter, sit in the garden over the village green in summer, and have a pie whatever the weather.
copy.services_intro: Pies made here, in small batches.

menu.title: The pies
menu.blurb: Made here in small batches: Steak & Kidney in Guinness gravy, Steak, Ale & Mushroom with Harvey's Sussex Best, Chicken, Ham & Leek, Lamb & Minted Potato, Cider Pork & Bramley Apple, Steak & Stilton and Steak & Black Pudding. With chips or mash, seasonal veg and gravy.

menu.title: Veggie pie
menu.blurb: Chickpea, sweet potato and baby spinach in a creamy coconut and tomato curry sauce.

menu.title: Not in the mood for pie?
menu.blurb: Beer-battered cod and chips, homemade lasagne, or wholetail scampi.

menu.title: At the bar
menu.blurb: Well-kept ales including Harvey's, lagers, a good wine list, cocktails and spirits.

menu.title: The garden
menu.blurb: Tables looking over the village green and the church. Dogs very welcome.

copy.menu_note: Taken from your menu on Google (August 2026). Send us any changes and we'll update it.
faqs: It's worth booking at weekends. Our kitchen is small, so we can only take groups of up to six.
Thursday 12–3pm and 5:30–10pm, Friday 12–3pm and 5:30–11pm, Saturday 12–11pm and Sunday 12–10pm. Closed Monday to Wednesday.
Yes, dogs are welcome inside and in the garden.
Yes, the Chickpea, Sweet Potato & Spinach pie is vegetarian. Tell us about any allergies when you order.
There's free on-street parking in the village.
copy.quote_intro: Booking a table? Tell us the day, time and how many of you (up to six) and we'll confirm.
